technical_complexity.rationale: Building a network model from fragmented SCADA, billing, meter and GIS data and running power flow on it is domain-heavy engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Utility integrations and sales cycles are slow to displace, but funded grid software vendors overlap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Itron and others announced grid edge AI partnerships in 2026.

market_need_then: Company says 94 percent of outage minutes start below the substation and claims deployments serving 10M+ customers (self-reported); DER growth increases the visibility gap.
